binding_selection_confound: Both retained runs were bound to Bugfix at spawn with guards disabled (run-b3a751/run-context.json:8-9; run-ec6204/run-context.json:8-9), but visible workflow engagement followed an initial handoff and reminder (run-b3a751/transcript/messages.json ordinals 19-22; run-ec6204/transcript/messages.json ordinals 17-20). Binding versus explicit selection, initial guidance salience, and reminder timing therefore confound causal attribution. The evidence does not establish that wording alone caused the chronology failures or that this replacement will fix workflow activation.

Both retained runs were bound to Bugfix at spawn, but first engaged its progression after an initial handoff and an explicit incomplete-workflow reminder: run-b3a751/run-context.json:7-10 and transcript/messages.json ordinals 19-22; run-ec6204/run-context.json:7-10 and transcript/messages.json ordinals 17-20. Binding is not proof that initial guidance was salient or followed, and committed history does not include every live broadcast. These records cannot isolate wording effects from binding versus explicit selection, initial guidance visibility, or reminder effects; the proposal neither attributes the failures solely to guidance nor claims to fix activation.
